posts.text: Right?! I'm doing all my home renovations myself because I can't afford otherwise. I have no idea how people are affording all this stuff without going into horrific debt. Don't get me wrong. There were a lot of great options brought up in the replies, but they won't work for folks struggling to make ends meet.

I'll personally go electric as soon as I'm done fixing my house and can save up for a down payment + charger installation. That'll take years though!

posts.text:
You want to pay for my all my home's repairs? Because that's what's holding me back from being able to afford going electric (and solar).

I also own an e-bike and use it whenever possible, so I'm not really worried about the little bit I drive my gasoline car. I'll go electric when I can afford it.
